testSuites.name: Discovery Queries - Multi-Attribute Product Search
testSuites.description: Tests natural language product discovery with multiple fashion-specific attributes
testSuites.capability: Discovery queries with complex attribute extraction

turns.message: Show me a floral maxi dress for a beach wedding under $400
turns.notes: Should extract multiple fashion attributes: pattern, occasion, length, price

turns.message: Make it more casual, like something I could wear to a daytime brunch
turns.notes: Should update occasion while maintaining category and other constraints

turns.message: Actually, I prefer a mini dress instead
turns.notes: Should update length/category while maintaining pattern, occasion, price

turns.message: Show me it in white or cream
turns.notes: Should add color constraint to existing search

testSuites.name: Context Carry-Over and Constraint Merging
testSuites.description: Tests maintaining conversation context across multiple refinements

turns.message: I need something elegant for a formal evening event
turns.notes: Initial vague query with occasion and style
Should merge category with existing constraints
Should add price while maintaining all previous constraints
Should add material constraint, maintain all others
Final refinement - all constraints should be maintained

testSuites.name: Category Switching Detection
testSuites.description: Tests distinguishing between follow-up refinements and new searches

turns.notes: Initial search for tops
Refinement - should maintain category and price
Category change - should reset category, may keep price
Refinement after category switch - should update price for swimsuits
Another category change - should reset again

testSuites.name: Vague and Underspecified Queries
testSuites.description: Tests handling unclear requests and asking clarifying questions

turns.notes: Very vague - may trigger clarifying questions or broad results
Partial clarification - should add category, maintain season

turns.message: Something I can wear to the beach
turns.notes: Still somewhat vague but adds occasion context
More specific - should add pattern and price constraints

testSuites.name: PDP Suitability Queries
testSuites.description: Tests product-specific Q&A and suitability assessment
testSuites.capability: PDP context queries and product evaluation

turns.notes: Initial discovery query

turns.message: Is the first one appropriate for a wedding?
turns.notes: Product-specific question - should evaluate product attributes for wedding suitability
Another product suitability question for different occasion
Material/care question - should reference product's material and care attributes

testSuites.name: Constraint Relaxation and No-Results Handling
testSuites.description: Tests handling over-constrained queries and finding closest matches

turns.message: Show me a red silk maxi dress with long sleeves, v-neck, floral pattern, under $200, size 4, for a formal wedding
turns.notes: Over-constrained query - may return no results, should trigger rescue search

turns.message: Show me close matches, price can be higher
turns.notes: Explicit relaxation request - should remove or increase price constraint
Further relaxation - should remove neckline constraint
Pattern flexibility - should expand pattern options

testSuites.name: Complex Multi-Attribute Fashion Queries
testSuites.description: Tests handling fashion-specific attributes (style, fit, embellishments, collections)

turns.message: I'm looking for a fitted A-line dress with lace embellishments for a holiday party
turns.notes: Complex query with multiple fashion-specific attributes

turns.message: From the Holiday collection if available
turns.notes: Should add collection constraint while maintaining all others

turns.message: In navy or burgundy, midi length
turns.notes: Should add color and length, maintain style, fit, embellishments, occasion, collection
Should add sleeve preference, exclude sleeveless

testSuites.name: Long Multi-Turn Conversation with Context Switches
testSuites.description: Tests maintaining and switching context through extended conversations

turns.message: I need an outfit for a beach wedding
turns.notes: Initial vague query
Category specification - should maintain occasion
Style refinement - should maintain category and occasion
Price constraint - should maintain all previous constraints

turns.message: Actually, I also need a swimsuit for the trip
turns.notes: Category switch - should reset to swimsuits, may keep price or reset
Swimsuit refinement - should maintain swimsuit category

turns.message: Back to the dresses - show me maxi length
turns.notes: Return to dresses - may need to restore previous dress constraints
Final refinement - should maintain all dress constraints

metadata.description: Comprehensive stress test prompts for fashion shopping assistant covering all core capabilities

usage.description: Use this JSON file for automated testing of the fashion shopping assistant

fields.expectedType: Either 'new_search', 'follow_up', or 'pdp_suitability' - the expected threadType from context gatekeeper
fields.message: The user message to send to the assistant
fields.expectedConstraints: Partial constraint object showing what should be extracted/updated
fields.notes: Additional context about what to verify

testing: Run each test suite sequentially with a fresh session
Check that constraints match expectedConstraints (partial match is acceptable)
Validate that category switches trigger new_search
Monitor response times (should be under 4 seconds)
Check error handling for edge cases
